context.problem_statement: Detect and remove outliers from a scientific measurement dataset using multiple methods. Apply: (1) IQR method: outliers are values below Q1 - 1.5*IQR or above Q3 + 1.5*IQR, (2) Z-score method: outliers are values where |z| > 3, (3) Modified Z-score method using median absolute deviation: |0.6745*(x - median)/MAD| > 3.5. For each method, report: number of outliers detected, their values and indices, the mean and standard deviation before and after removal. Compare whether all three methods agree on which points are outliers.
context.expert_knowledge: IQR = Q3 - Q1. Z-score = (x - mean) / std. Modified Z-score = 0.6745*(x-median)/MAD where MAD = median(|x - median(x)|). IQR method is robust to outliers; Z-score is influenced by outliers themselves. Modified Z-score is best for small samples. Convention: modified Z > 3.5 flags outlier. After removal, recompute statistics to show impact.
